## LLM017 Vector store access inside a transaction

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Level | error |
| Framework | Both |
| Autofix | no patch; fix it by hand as described below |
| More | https://github.com/pgy763/llm-lint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#llm017 |
| Turn it off | `LLM017: off` in .llm-lint.yml, or `--disable LLM017` on the command line |

Vector writes and searches both compute an embedding and then make a network call: waiting those hundreds of milliseconds inside a transaction keeps a database connection checked out by this thread, and under load the first error is "cannot get a connection".

To mute it in one place, put `// llm-lint:ignore LLM017` on that line or the line above.
<!-- /generated:llm017 -->

## What it looks like

`vectorStore.similaritySearch(...)` or `.add(...)` inside `@Transactional`.

## How to fix

Do vector I/O outside the transaction. It is a network call and holds the database connection exactly like a model call does.
